pages.title: Wormhole Frame Casing
pages.text: A casing threaded with negative mass and exotic matter, the ingredients a traversable wormhole needs to keep its throat open. It feels as if it is pushing my hand away and pulling it in at the same time.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)An Einstein-Rosen bridge collapses unless its throat is held open by negative energy. I built the frame from negative mass ingots and exotic matter crystal over a hyperframe, and the bridge stopped pinching shut.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Mass Manipulation.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Einstein-Rosen Bridge Projector.
